sections.advice: Treat High point in Cobham → Brentford as bend craft. Brake early, look high through the turn, and keep throttle changes gentle. It is more satisfying to link ten clean bends than rescue one silly one.

Scenic stretch in Watford → Photo stop near Hatfield is the reward section in London motorcycle escapes. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

sections.to: Near Stanford-le-Hope, on the way back
sections.advice: Photo stop near Hatfield → Near Stanford-le-Hope, on the way back is shade riding: beautiful, cooler and sometimes slick. Expect damp patches, leaves, gravel and wildlife where the trees meet the road.

sections.from: Near Stanford-le-Hope, on the way back

sections.advice: Food stop in Gravesend → Back to New is the logistics leg. Watch junctions, villages and speed changes, then let the roadbook do its job: move you out of the clutter without spending your best attention too early.

safetyMarkers.note: Respect posted limits and assume enforcement near villages, viewpoints and main-road joins.

scenicChapters.title: 18th-Century Royal Palace at Caserta with  → Historic Centre of Naples
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 34 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Amalfi Coast Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 25 km this is Amalfi Coast Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Watchtowers WP 4/76 to 4/80 including the  → Fortlet Lochmühle
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 37 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-watchtowers-wp-4-76-to-4-80-inclu.story: A 278 km round trip from Echzell - roughly 4 h 48 in the saddle. It goes by way of Fortlet Lochmühle, Watchtower WP 3/23*, Watchtower WP 2/31 and Watchtower WP 1/73. The line favours views over speed.
